title: Grade 5 French — Thu, May 21
description: Animals & Describing (Les Animaux et la Description) — Last Week Day 4
subject: french

questions.question: What is the French word for 'dog'?
questions.explanation: 'Chien' (masc.) / 'Chienne' (fem.) = dog. Chat = cat, Cheval = horse, Lapin = rabbit.

questions.question: How do you say 'cat' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Chat' (masc.) / 'Chatte' (fem.) = cat. Chien = dog, Vache = cow, Cochon = pig.

questions.question: What is 'un oiseau'?
questions.explanation: 'Un oiseau' = a bird. Plural: 'des oiseaux'. The 'x' plural is common in French (eau → eaux).

questions.question: How do you describe a big dog in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un grand chien' = a big dog. 'Grand' is one of the few adjectives that comes BEFORE the noun (BAGS rule).

questions.question: What is the French word for 'horse'?
questions.explanation: 'Cheval' = horse (masc.). Plural: 'chevaux'. Vache = cow, Mouton = sheep, Cochon = pig.

questions.question: How do you say 'The cat is black and white' in French?
options: Le chat est noir et blanc
La chat est noir et blanc
Le chat sont noirs et blancs
Le chat est noire et blanche
questions.explanation: 'Le chat est noir et blanc' = The cat is black and white. 'Chat' is masculine so 'noir' and 'blanc' stay masculine.

questions.question: What is 'une vache'?
questions.explanation: 'Une vache' = a cow. Vache is feminine, hence 'une'. Mouton (sheep), Cochon (pig), Cheval (horse).

questions.question: How do you say 'I have a rabbit' in French?
questions.explanation: 'J'ai un lapin' = I have a rabbit. 'Lapin' is masculine, so 'un'.

questions.question: The adjective BAGS rule says some adjectives come BEFORE the noun. BAGS stands for:
questions.explanation: BAGS: Beauty (beau/belle), Age (jeune/vieux), Goodness/Badness (bon/mauvais), Size (grand/petit). These come before the noun.

questions.question: How do you describe 'a fast horse' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un cheval rapide' = a fast horse. 'Rapide' is not a BAGS adjective, so it comes AFTER the noun.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'fish' (the animal)?
questions.explanation: 'Poisson' = fish. Oiseau = bird, Grenouille = frog, Serpent = snake.

questions.question: How do you say 'My dog is very cute' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mon chien est très mignon' = My dog is very cute. 'Chien' is masculine, so 'mignon' (not mignonne).

questions.question: What does 'fort' mean as an adjective?
How do you say 'There is a bird in the tree' in French?
options: Il a un oiseau dans l'arbre
Il est un oiseau dans l'arbre
Il y a un oiseau dans l'arbre
questions.explanation: 'Il y a' = 'there is/there are'. 'Il y a un oiseau dans l'arbre' = There is a bird in the tree.
